**Traffic on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section is prohibited**  
09:21, 10.04.2026

Traffic for motor vehicles is prohibited on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section, the Roads Department of Georgia’s Ministry of Infrastructure reports.

According to the Roads Department, the avalanche danger level on this section is high.

“According to the Roads Department of Georgia’s Ministry of Infrastructure, and based on information from the National Environmental Agency, the avalanche danger level is high on the Gudauri (Posta)-Kobi section of the international Mtskheta-Stepantsminda-Larsi highway, which is why the movement of all types of motor vehicles is temporarily prohibited on this section.

According to the National Environmental Agency, traffic on the Mleta-Gudauri section will be allowed in nonstop transit mode,” the statement says.
